description:
Level of Difficulty: Easy

A 1.6 km. loop trail through the forest.
directions: From Terrace drive west along Highway 16 and approximately 200 m. west of the Kalum River turn north onto the West Kalum forestry road at the Tempo gas station. At 26 km. you reach the Redsand Lake Demonstration Forest which has 3 short and easy trails which begin and end at the Redsand campground.

stats.Closure: Footbridges have been damaged by recent flood events and are unsafe to use. Trail is closed.
stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - North Coast - Kalum - Cassiar

title: Red Sand Intro Trail
